title: Why You Earn 3% Less Than Your Own Fund — $340K Gone
hook: Your fund returned 10% last year. You personally made 4%. That gap has a name, a cause, and a six-figure price tag.
angle: The DALBAR behavior gap — 30 years of data proving investors systematically underperform their own funds by panic-selling and FOMO-buying, costing hundreds of thousands in compounded losses
audience: Anyone with a 401k, IRA, or brokerage account who has ever moved money in reaction to market news
key_numbers: 94% of buy-and-hold investors beat active traders
